title: The Pleasure Pit
writer: René Barjavel, André Cayatte, Mario Forni
actors: Pascale Audret, Jane Birkin, Serge Gainsbourg
plot: A rebellious socially-conscious man travels to Nepal to find his deadbeat dad. He meets Jane, a beautiful hippie girl hooked on drugs. He is forced to steal artifacts for his father's slimy employer to earn money to help Jane.
